scope: AGC 2019 irrigation counter and Grodan root-zone observations

source_dataset.title: Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge, Second Edition (2019)
source_dataset.official_release_checksum_status: Version 2 MD5 verified; 43 common CSVs differ only by CRLF-to-LF conversion; one common file byte-identical

time.timezone: not declared by the source; timestamps remain timezone-naive

irrigation_counter.missing_block_rule: retain the last valid counter and difference against the first resumed reading
irrigation_counter.unscheduled_decrease_rule: flag as counter correction, retain the previous high-water mark, and do not create an irrigation event
irrigation_counter.boundary_rule: report first and final campaign days separately from interior-day reconciliation

digilog_zero_audit.decision: zero WC/EC values are equipment-failure sentinels and are retained as missing with field-level flags

production_date_repair.reason: only out-of-campaign harvest; exactly 365 days before 2020-02-14, matching the first harvest date in another compartment
production_date_repair.rule: retain raw serial, add corrected serial and explicit source_year_offset_plus_365_days flag
